subtitle: Amagumbi enombolo nokuhlukana
short_description: Gcwalisa amagumbi angajwayelekile ukuze izinombolo eziphindiwe zihlukane.
description:
Gcwalisa igumbi ngalinye elingajwayelekile ngezinombolo ezingu-1 kuya kobukhulu balo. Uma inombolo k ivela kabili emugqeni noma kukholomu, kumelwe kube okungenani izikwele ezingu-k phakathi kwazo.

Thepha isikwele bese uthayipha idijithi ezingu-1 kuya ku-4 ezinkinobhweni ezinkulu. Isikwele ngasinye sikhombisa inhlamvu yegumbi nobukhulu balo ecaleni kwenombolo.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
